title: ds004100 v1.1.3 retrieval manifest and outcome-blind case-selection proposal
body:
## 1. Retrieval manifest (OpenNeuro ds004100 snapshot 1.1.3, CC0; user-approved download 2026-10-31)
- Source list: OpenNeuro GraphQL `snapshot(datasetId:"ds004100",tag:"1.1.3")` recursive walk (work/T0015/fetch_tree.py); identical (path+size) to the A0070 attachment ds004100_v113_tree_full.json.
- Location: `data/ds004100-1.1.3/` (project root, gitignored). Raw files not modified.
- Downloaded 1343/1343 files = 1341 release files (14,196,260,504 B, matches snapshot summary) + .gitattributes (284 B) + .datalad/config (63 B); total 14,196,260,851 B. 0 failed, 0 retries.
- Verification: every file present with expected size; no extra or partial files; 57 sub-* directories; sub-HUP132 absent.
- sha256 for all 1343 files in attached retrieval_manifest.csv (path, bytes, sha256); manifest file sha256 = 62e8da45fa70ed025c10efdb5b053bdce53d6c99a1e0b7d43bbd13b249f94c5d.
- Cross-check: README, CHANGES, dataset_description.json, participants.json, sub-HUP060 coordsystem.json and electrodes.tsv sha256 equal the values recorded in A0070.
- Content counts (file names + sidecars): 319 EDF (208 ictal, 111 interictal); 208 events.tsv, each with 'sz onset' and 'sz offset' rows (208 each); SOZ- and resect-tagged channels present in 57/57; contacts with numeric xyz in 57/57. Implant from participants.tsv agrees with acq- file label for 57/57 (37 SEEG / 20 ECoG).
- participants.tsv: 58 rows (includes sub-HUP132, which has no recordings in 1.1.3); one participant_id has a trailing space ('sub-HUP151 '), stripped in derived JSON only. Therapy levels present: ABLATION and RESECTION only - no RNS rows (resolves A0070 to_verify item; no stimulation cases in this dataset).

## 2. Outcome sealing
- Outcome columns per participants.json: 'outcome' (S/F/NR) and 'engel' (1-4). Written only to work/T0015/outcomes_to_seal.json for the lead to seal; no outcome values in any artifact or log.
- Non-outcome linkage (therapy, implant, sex, age, hand, target, lesion_status, age_onset) in work/T0015/linkage.json (not committed).
- Raw `data/ds004100-1.1.3/participants.tsv` still contains outcome columns: lead should restrict access to it.

## 3. Cohort split
- See A0071-CohortSplit: 56 eligible (sub-HUP165 excluded: no ictal run); 34 development / 22 test; stratified by therapy x implant; seed 20261101; split_hash 255216f575a2e635e3fcece16cc2f3e3ea1d12c6222676f1281d41f90d17fa23.

## 4. Case-selection proposal (protocol max_cases = 10; outcome-blind)
Rule (work/T0015/select_cases.py, seed 20261101): qualified = >=2 ictal runs with events.tsv, >=1 interictal run, >=1 SOZ-tagged and >=1 resect-tagged channel, contacts with xyz. SOZ/resect overlap was deliberately NOT used, because it correlates with outcome. Quotas give balance on therapy and implant in each partition: development 6 = ABLATION|SEEG 2, ABLATION|ECOG 1, RESECTION|ECOG 2, RESECTION|SEEG 1 (3 ablation / 3 resection, 3 SEEG / 3 ECoG); test 4 = one per cell (2/2, 2/2). Random pick within each cell. Qualified pool per cell: development {"ABLATION|SEEG": 15, "ABLATION|ECOG": 1, "RESECTION|SEEG": 6, "RESECTION|ECOG": 10}; test {"ABLATION|SEEG": 9, "ABLATION|ECOG": 1, "RESECTION|SEEG": 4, "RESECTION|ECOG": 6}. The ABLATION|ECOG cell has only one qualified case per partition, so sub-HUP126 and sub-HUP114 were forced picks.

## 5. Open items / limitations (to_verify, not done in this task)
- Per-case signal QC (EDF headers, units, sampling rate, flat/noisy channels, line noise) and anatomy QC are not yet done; no PatientCase/QCReport committed here.
- Coordinate frame/unit conflict (coordsystem.json says fsaverage, unit 'm'; values are mm-scale; README says MNI ICBM152) remains to_verify before any geometry artifact.
- No MRI/CT/DWI in the release: a template connectome is required.
- No stimulation (RNS/DBS/VNS) cases: this dataset can test only resection/ablation questions.
- Per-patient follow-up duration is not in the metadata.
